personality_one_liner: An ultra-luxurious, high-trust digital gold and fine jewellery platform combining editorial elegance with financial utility.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room. Avoid dense clusters; give high-value actions clear thumb zones.

android_fallback.reason: Blur on Android is typically weaker or buggy depending on the view below.

do's: Apply Liquid Glass strictly to user app elements: Top-left menu button, Tab bar, Side Menu Drawer, Cards, Sheets, Buy widget, and SIP screen.
Use BlurView with specific intensity and tint from liquid_glass spec.
Ensure a 0.5pt hairline border on all glass components.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or catalogue item backgrounds
Avoid glass effects on form fields or text inputs

screens.name: Side Drawer Menu
screens.purpose: Primary side navigation providing utility access without interrupting main flow.
screens.layout: Use Liquid Glass frosted background (intensity 70 dark/50 light) for the drawer panel. Header: Profile Avatar, Name, Phone. Body: List of menu items with Lucide icons. Footer: Contact & Brand.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase live prices, portfolio status, and entry points into digital gold and jewellery.

states.loading: Shimmer on price cards and banners
states.error: Toast or inline banner for failed live price fetch

screens.layout: Top Left: Floating liquid glass 3-dot menu icon opening drawer. Hero: Live gold/silver price cards in Liquid Glass. Buy Widget in glass. Floating Glass Tab Bar at the bottom.

screens.name: Catalogue (Jewellery Grid)
screens.purpose: Editorial grid to browse physical jewellery without cropping details.

states.loading: Skeleton grid with shimmering surfaceSecondary blocks
states.empty: Icon + 'No items found' + Clear Filters CTA
states.error: Failed to load catalogue inline error

screens.layout: Two-column grid layout. Product image container: MUST use surfaceSecondary (#FDF8E8 Cream) with `objectFit: 'contain'`. Beneath image: Product name, specs, and price with Gold primary text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Drawer Menu specific setup: Ensure left side drawer navigation matches exact user request with Liquid Glass UI applied to the entire drawer panel.
Implement Liquid Glass for the Top-Left 3-dot Menu Button (pill radius, frosted effect, 0.5 hairline border).
Implement Floating Tab Bar using Liquid Glass UI (margin bottom 24, horizontal margin 16, radius 32, frosted background with 0.5 pt border).
Apply Liquid Glass to Cards, Sheets, Buy Widget, and SIP Screen.
Ensure theme.ts is updated with new keys: glassFillLight, glassFillDark, glassBorderLight, glassBorderDark, glassHighlight.
For Android fallback where blur may fail, use a 95% opacity solid background of the surface color to mimic depth without visual glitches.
Strictly follow the user's color palette (Gold #D4AF37, Cream #FDF8E8, Deep Gold #8A6E1C, Ink #111827) and keep the luxe feeling.
Use 'Inter' font for all typography as explicitly requested, ensuring standard hierarchical sizing (sm to 2xl) without using heavy weights.
